label: TP
reason: User input retrieved via getParameterMap() flows through doSomething() (which performs a harmless Base64 round-trip preserving the payload) into bar, which is directly concatenated into the SQL query string used by JDBCtemplate.queryForList(). No effective sanitization occurs on the reported path, enabling SQL injection.

evidence.note: Round-trip Base64 encoding/decoding preserves input content
Concatenated user input into SQL string without escaping
